description: Supplement of the interface-sizes vocabulary: the size keys the commons cartridges' size_key maps need for machine structure and drives and the base file did not define (a square hollow section and the socket or sleeve that takes it; a keyed shaft end and the keyed bore that takes it; a 10 mm plain pin and the hole that takes it; M6, M8 and M10 screw joints; the 75 mm and 100 mm square display mounting patterns). Same rules as the base: two interfaces mate only when their resolved size keys are EQUAL, and every dimension cites a public standard or manufacturer source. Merged into interface-sizes when the vocabulary is loaded.

review.note: Keys, labels and definitions drafted in one pass by an agent (machine-elements lane, 2026-11-17). No language facet has had a native review; Spanish is the bar a reviewer should read first. Facts were read from the cited sources on the access date.

definition.en: A square hollow section 80 × 80 mm across the outside, and the socket, cap or sliding sleeve that takes that outside. The wall thickness is not part of the key: it changes the bore, not what fits around the section.
definition.es: Un perfil tubular cuadrado de 80 × 80 mm por fuera, y el alojamiento, la tapa o la camisa deslizante que recibe ese exterior. El espesor de pared no forma parte de la clave: cambia el hueco interior, no lo que ajusta alrededor del perfil.
definition.fr: Un profil creux carré de 80 × 80 mm à l'extérieur, et le logement, le chapeau ou le manchon coulissant qui reçoit cet extérieur. L'épaisseur de paroi ne fait pas partie de la clé : elle change le vide intérieur, pas ce qui s'ajuste autour du profil.
definition.pt: Um perfil tubular quadrado de 80 × 80 mm por fora, e o encaixe, a tampa ou a luva deslizante que recebe esse exterior. A espessura da parede não faz parte da chave: muda o vão interior, não o que se ajusta à volta do perfil.

outside_square.note: listed as 80x80 at 5 mm and 6 mm wall; the key fixes the outside only

sources.title: Cold Formed Square Hollow Sections, dimensions table (associated standard BS EN 10219)
sources.supports: 80x80 square hollow section listed at 5 mm (11.3 kg/m) and 6 mm (13.2 kg/m) wall

entries.notes: Added for an indexed column and the sleeve, socket and cap that fit it (commons cartridges indexed-column and index-carriage). The fit between the section and its partner (sliding clearance, press, weld prep) is the partner's design choice and not a fact of the key. A rectangular section would need its own key: this one says both sides are the 80 mm square.

label.en: 19 mm shaft with a 6 mm parallel key
label.es: Flecha de 19 mm con cuña paralela de 6 mm
label.fr: Arbre de 19 mm à clavette parallèle de 6 mm
label.pt: Eixo de 19 mm com chaveta paralela de 6 mm

definition.en: A round shaft end of 19 mm diameter carrying a 6 × 6 mm parallel key, and the keyed bore of the hub that takes it. 19 mm lies in the 17 to 22 mm shaft range that the 6 × 6 key is assigned to.
definition.es: Un extremo de flecha redonda de 19 mm de diámetro con una cuña paralela de 6 × 6 mm, y el barreno con cuñero de la maza que lo recibe. 19 mm queda dentro del intervalo de flechas de 17 a 22 mm al que se asigna la cuña de 6 × 6.
definition.fr: Un bout d'arbre rond de 19 mm de diamètre portant une clavette parallèle de 6 × 6 mm, et l'alésage claveté du moyeu qui le reçoit. 19 mm se situe dans la plage d'arbres de 17 à 22 mm à laquelle la clavette de 6 × 6 est attribuée.
definition.pt: Uma ponta de eixo redondo de 19 mm de diâmetro com uma chaveta paralela de 6 × 6 mm, e o furo com rasgo de chaveta do cubo que a recebe. 19 mm fica dentro da gama de eixos de 17 a 22 mm a que se atribui a chaveta de 6 × 6.

shaft_diameter.note: inside the 17 to 22 mm range the 6 x 6 key is listed for

shaft_keyway_depth.note: t1, from the 1968 edition of the standard, which is withdrawn

hub_keyway_depth.note: t2, from the 1968 edition of the standard, which is withdrawn

sources.title: Parallel Keys DIN 6885, steel: product table with the shaft diameter each key is for
sources.supports: 6 x 6 key: width 6 mm h9, height 6 mm, for shaft diameters 17 to 22 mm

sources.title: DIN 6885-1 parallel keys, dimensions (edition 08/1968, withdrawn)
sources.supports: 6 x 6 key on shafts over 17 up to 22 mm: shaft keyway depth t1 3.5 mm, hub keyway depth t2 2.8 mm

entries.notes: Added for a winding drum on a motor shaft (commons cartridge cable-spool, bore 19 mm with a 6 mm keyway). The key names the shaft end only: it is not a motor frame size, and a motor with this shaft end may carry any flange. The diameter tolerance of the shaft and the fit of the bore are the two parts' design choices and not facts of the key. The keyway depths are from a withdrawn edition: check the current standard before cutting to them.

label.en: 10 mm plain pin in a hole
label.es: Perno liso de 10 mm en un barreno
label.fr: Goupille lisse de 10 mm dans un trou
label.pt: Pino liso de 10 mm num furo

definition.en: A plain cylindrical pin of 10 mm nominal diameter, and the 10 mm hole or guide bore that takes it: the pin of a pin-and-hole adjustment, a locating pin, a hitch pin. The pin is the male side and the hole the female side. Head, grip and length are the pin's own design and not part of the key.
definition.es: Un perno cilíndrico liso de 10 mm de diámetro nominal, y el barreno o la guía de 10 mm que lo recibe: el perno de un ajuste de perno y barreno, un perno localizador, un perno de enganche. El perno es el lado macho y el barreno el lado hembra. La cabeza, la empuñadura y el largo son diseño del propio perno y no forman parte de la clave.
definition.fr: Une goupille cylindrique lisse de 10 mm de diamètre nominal, et le trou ou l'alésage de guidage de 10 mm qui la reçoit : la goupille d'un réglage à goupille et trous, une goupille de positionnement, une goupille d'attelage. La goupille est le côté mâle et le trou le côté femelle. La tête, la prise et la longueur relèvent de la conception de la goupille et ne font pas partie de la clé.
definition.pt: Um pino cilíndrico liso de 10 mm de diâmetro nominal, e o furo ou a guia de 10 mm que o recebe: o pino de um ajuste de pino e furos, um pino de posicionamento, um pino de engate. O pino é o lado macho e o furo o lado fêmea. A cabeça, a pega e o comprimento são projeto do próprio pino e não fazem parte da chave.

pin_diameter.note: d, the nominal diameter; the standard offers tolerance class m6 or h8 and allows others by agreement

end_chamfer.note: c, stated as approximate for d = 10

sources.title: ISO 2338:1997, Parallel pins, of unhardened steel and austenitic stainless steel (preview of the standard, Table 1 — Dimensions)
sources.supports: Table 1 lists nominal diameter d = 10 mm with tolerance class m6/h8 and chamfer c approximately 2 mm; footnote 1 allows other tolerances as agreed

entries.notes: Added for a pull pin and the two parts it locks (commons cartridges index-pin, index-carriage and indexed-column). The key says only that both sides are the 10 mm pin: the clearance between pin and hole is each part's design choice (a pull pin that must drop in by hand is made smaller than the hole on purpose), and a pin made to this key need not be an ISO 2338 pin. The standard is cited for the nominal diameter and its tolerance classes.

definition.en: The bolt pattern of one M8 screw: the clamped part's clearance-hole side (male) into an M8 thread under its face (female), a tapped hole, a nut or an insert. Both are framed on the clamped face. As m5-screw-joint, at M8.
definition.es: El patrón de un tornillo M8: el lado del barreno de paso de la pieza sujeta (macho) hacia una rosca M8 bajo su cara (hembra), un barreno roscado, una tuerca o un inserto. Ambos se enmarcan en la cara sujeta. Como m5-screw-joint, en M8.
definition.fr: Le motif d'une vis M8 : le côté trou de passage de la pièce serrée (mâle) vers un taraudage M8 sous sa face (femelle), un trou taraudé, un écrou ou un insert. Les deux sont repérés sur la face serrée. Comme m5-screw-joint, en M8.
definition.pt: O padrão de um parafuso M8: o lado do furo de passagem da peça apertada (macho) para uma rosca M8 sob a sua face (fêmea), um furo roscado, uma porca ou um inserto. Ambos são referenciados na face apertada. Como m5-screw-joint, em M8.

sources.title: DIN 912 / ISO 4762 socket head cap screws, dimensions table
sources.supports: M8 row: pitch P 1.25 mm; head height k max 8.00 mm; hexagon socket s nominal 6 mm

entries.notes: Added for the bolted joints of machine structure in the solid commons (a display arm hung from a beam, a mounting plate, a foot), where an M5 joint is too small to be honest. Polarity follows m5-screw-joint: the clearance-hole side is male, the thread female. The screw's length, head and property class, and the diameter of the clearance hole, are the joint's own choice and not part of the key.

label.es: Patrón de montaje de pantalla 75 × 75 M4 (VESA MIS-D 75)
label.fr: Motif de fixation d'écran 75 × 75 M4 (VESA MIS-D 75)
label.pt: Padrão de fixação de ecrã 75 × 75 M4 (VESA MIS-D 75)

definition.en: Four M4 screws on a 75 mm square, hole centre to hole centre: the back of a flat display with its four M4 threads (female) and the plate of an arm, bracket or adapter with its four clearance holes (male). Both are framed on the clamped face at the centre of the square. The pattern the VESA Flat Display Mounting Interface names MIS-D 75.
definition.es: Cuatro tornillos M4 en un cuadrado de 75 mm, de centro a centro de barreno: el dorso de una pantalla plana con sus cuatro roscas M4 (hembra) y la placa de un brazo, soporte o adaptador con sus cuatro barrenos de paso (macho). Ambos se enmarcan en la cara sujeta, en el centro del cuadrado. El patrón que la interfaz VESA de montaje de pantallas planas (FDMI) llama MIS-D 75.
definition.fr: Quatre vis M4 sur un carré de 75 mm, d'axe en axe : le dos d'un écran plat avec ses quatre taraudages M4 (femelle) et la platine d'un bras, d'un support ou d'un adaptateur avec ses quatre trous de passage (mâle). Les deux sont repérés sur la face serrée, au centre du carré. Le motif que l'interface VESA de fixation des écrans plats (FDMI) nomme MIS-D 75.
definition.pt: Quatro parafusos M4 num quadrado de 75 mm, de centro a centro de furo: a traseira de um ecrã plano com as suas quatro roscas M4 (fêmea) e a placa de um braço, suporte ou adaptador com os seus quatro furos de passagem (macho). Ambos são referenciados na face apertada, no centro do quadrado. O padrão a que a interface VESA de fixação de ecrãs planos (FDMI) chama MIS-D 75.

hole_spacing.note: centre to centre, the same horizontally and vertically

sources.title: VESA Mount Sizes and Types Guide
sources.supports: a VESA mount size is the distance in millimetres between the four mounting holes, measured centre to centre, width first; size chart row 75 x 75: type MIS-D 75, screws M4

sources.title: VESA Mounts for Monitors and TVs (the page was served in Spanish)
sources.supports: table of common patterns lists 75 x 75 mm; table of types: MIS-D covers 75 x 75 mm and 100 x 100 mm. The page states no screw size

entries.notes: Added for the display faces of the solid commons' display arms, plates and adapters, so a display and what carries it mate by key. Polarity follows the screw joints: the clearance-hole side (the mount) is male, the threaded side (the display) female. A square pattern, so symmetry 4. The 100 mm square is a different key (vesa-mis-d-100); a plate drilled for both declares one interface per square. The sources read are a mount maker's guide and a manufacturer's summary; the VESA FDMI document itself was not read, so weight limits, screw length and the larger patterns (MIS-E 200 x 100, MIS-F 200 x 200 and up, which the guides give as M6 or M8) are not part of this key.
